title.zh: 卷441 列傳二百二十八 潘祖荫 李文田 孙诒经 夏同善 张家骧 张英麟 张仁黼 张亨嘉
title.en: Volume 441 Biographies 228: Pan Zuyin, Li Wentian, Sun Yijing, Xia Tongshan, Zhang Jiaxiang, Zhang Yinglin, Zhang Renfu, Zhang Hengjia
title.raw: 卷441 列傳二百二十八 潘祖荫 李文田 孙诒经 夏同善 张家骧 张英麟 张仁黼 张亨嘉

sentences.zh: 列傳二百二十八

translations.literal: Biographies, Number Two Hundred Twenty-Eight
translations.idiomatic: Biographies, No. 228

sentences.zh: 潘祖廕李文田孫詒經夏同善張家驤

translations.literal: Pan Zuyin, Li Wentian, Sun Yijing, Xia Tongshan, Zhang Jiaxiang
translations.idiomatic: Pan Zuyin, Li Wentian, Sun Yijing, Xia Tongshan, and Zhang Jiaxiang

sentences.zh: 張英麟張仁黼張亨嘉

translations.literal: Zhang Yinglin, Zhang Renfu, Zhang Hengjia
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yinglin, Zhang Renfu, and Zhang Hengjia

sentences.zh: 潘祖廕，字伯寅，江蘇吳縣人，大學士世恩孫。

translations.literal: Pan Zuyin, style name Boyin, was a man of Wuxian in Jiangsu, grandson of the Grand Secretary Shi'en.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Zuyin, courtesy name Boyin, was a native of Wuxian in Jiangsu and the grandson of Grand Secretary Shi'en.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年一甲三名進士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng he was third among the first-rank jinshi and was appointed Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 2 he placed third among the top-tier jinshi graduates and was appointed a Hanlin Compiler.

sentences.zh: 遷侍讀，入直南書房，充日講起居注官。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Reader-in-Waiting, entered service in the Southern Study, and served as Lecturer and Diarist of Imperial Activity.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Reader-in-Waiting, joined the Southern Study, and served as Lecturer and Diarist of Imperial Activity.

sentences.zh: 累遷侍讀學士，除大理寺少卿。

translations.literal: After successive promotions to Reader-in-Waiting with academic rank, he was appointed Vice President of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: After successive promotions to Reader-in-Waiting with academic rank, he was appointed Vice President of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 左宗棠被劾，召對簿，罪不測，祖廕上疏營救，且密薦其能，獄解，乃起獨領一軍。

translations.literal: When Zuo Zongtang was impeached and summoned for examination with uncertain punishment, Zuyin memorialized to rescue him and secretly recommended his ability; the case was resolved, and Zuo then rose to command an army alone.
translations.idiomatic: When Zuo Zongtang was impeached and summoned for a hearing with his punishment uncertain, Zuyin memorialized in his defense and secretly recommended his abilities; the case was resolved, and Zuo was then able to take sole command of an army.

sentences.zh: 十一年，詔求直言，祖廕念車駕還都，首斥奸佞，綱紀一新，為上勤聖學、求人才、整軍務、裕倉儲四事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year an edict sought forthright speech; Zuyin, mindful that the imperial carriage was returning to the capital, first called for expelling wicked ministers so discipline might be renewed, and presented four matters for the sovereign: diligent sacred learning, seeking talent, putting military affairs in order, and filling the granaries.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year an edict called for frank criticism; mindful that the court was returning to the capital, Zuyin urged first rooting out corrupt ministers so that discipline might be restored, and he presented four priorities for the emperor: diligent pursuit of learning, recruitment of talent, reform of military affairs, and replenishment of the granaries.

sentences.zh: 並請免賦以蘇民困，汰釐以紓民力，嚴軍律以拯民生，廣中額以收民心。

translations.literal: He also asked to remit levies to relieve the people's distress, to prune surtaxes to ease their strength, to enforce military discipline to save the people's livelihood, and to broaden metropolitan quotas to win the people's hearts.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked to remit taxes to ease the people's hardship, to cut surtaxes to lighten their burden, to enforce military discipline to protect civilian life, and to increase metropolitan examination quotas to win popular support.

sentences.zh: 纚纚數千言，稱旨。

translations.literal: His memorial ran to several thousand words in flowing detail and met with imperial approval.
translations.idiomatic: His memorial ran to several thousand eloquent words and pleased the throne.

sentences.zh: 遷光祿寺卿。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice President of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Vice President of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 與修治平寶鑑，書成，被賞賚。

translations.literal: He took part in compiling the Zhiping Baojian; when the book was completed he received rewards.
translations.idiomatic: He helped compile the Zhiping Baojian, and when the work was finished he received imperial rewards.

sentences.zh: 先後糾彈官吏不職狀，書凡數上，文若欽差勝保、直隸總督文煜、陝西巡撫英棨、布政使毛震壽、甘肅布政使恩麟、道員田在田諸人；

translations.literal: He repeatedly impeached officials for malfeasance; his memorials went up several times, naming among civil officials the imperial commissioner Senggebao, Zhili Governor Wen Yu, Shaanxi Governor Ying Qi, Provincial Administer Mao Zhenshou, Gansu Provincial Administer En Lin, Circuit Intendant Tian Zaitian, and others;
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly impeached officials for neglect of duty; his memorials went up many times, naming among civil officials the imperial commissioner Senggebao, the Zhili governor Wen Yu, the Shaanxi governor Ying Qi, the provincial administers Mao Zhenshou and En Lin of Gansu, the circuit intendant Tian Zaitian, and others;

sentences.zh: 武若提督孔廣順、總兵閻丕敘、副將張維義諸人。

translations.literal: and among military officials Regional Commander Kong Guangshun, Regional Commander Yan Pixu, Vice Regional Commander Zhang Weiyi, and others.
translations.idiomatic: and among military officers the regional commanders Kong Guangshun and Yan Pixu, the vice regional commander Zhang Weiyi, and others.

sentences.zh: 繇是直聲震朝端。

translations.literal: Thereby his reputation for uprightness shook the court.
translations.idiomatic: From this his reputation for integrity resounded at court.

sentences.zh: 同治三年，授左副都御史。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tongzhi he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 3 he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 坐會議何桂清罪未列銜，絓吏議。

translations.literal: He was censured because in the council on He Guiqing's crime he had not signed his name.
translations.idiomatic: He was censured for failing to affix his name to the deliberation on He Guiqing's case.

sentences.zh: 明年，恭親王奕訢獲譴，下群臣議。

translations.literal: The next year, when Prince Gong Yixin incurred imperial reprimand, the matter was referred to the ministers for discussion.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, when Prince Gong Yixin was reprimanded, the matter was referred to the ministers for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 祖廕念重臣進退，關係安危，疏請持平用中，酌予轉圜，袪世人惑。

translations.literal: Zuyin, mindful that a senior minister's advancement or withdrawal bore on security, memorialized asking balanced moderation and measured scope for a turnabout, to dispel public confusion.
translations.idiomatic: Zuyin, mindful that the rise or fall of a senior minister touched the realm's safety, memorialized asking that the case be handled with balanced moderation and that room be given for reconciliation, so as to dispel public alarm.

sentences.zh: 補工部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was made up as Vice President of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Vice President of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 七年，調戶部，充經筵講官。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue and appointed Lecturer at the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue and appointed a lecturer at the imperial classics colloquium.

sentences.zh: 坐失部印，褫職留任。

translations.literal: He was punished for losing a ministry seal; stripped of office but retained in post.
translations.idiomatic: He was punished for losing a ministry seal and was stripped of rank but kept in his post.

sentences.zh: 典順天鄉試，再坐中式舉人徐景春文理荒謬，鐫二級。

translations.literal: As chief examiner for the Shuntian provincial examination he was again demoted two grades because the successful candidate Xu Jingchun's literary composition was absurdly bad.
translations.idiomatic: As chief examiner for the Shuntian provincial examination he was again demoted two grades because the successful candidate Xu Jingchun's examination essay was absurdly poor.

sentences.zh: 十三年，特旨賞編修，仍入直。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year a special edict granted him the rank of Compiler and restored him to palace service.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year a special edict restored his Compiler rank and returned him to palace service.

sentences.zh: 錄輸餉功，釋處分。

translations.literal: Recording merit in transporting provisions, his punishment was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: His service in transporting provisions was recorded as merit, and his punishment was lifted.

sentences.zh: 光緒改元，授大理寺卿，補禮部右侍郎。

translations.literal: When Guangxu began his reign he was appointed President of the Court of Judicial Review and made Vice President of the Ministry of Rites on the right.
translations.idiomatic: When Guangxu ascended the throne he was appointed President of the Court of Judicial Review and Vice President of the Ministry of Rites on the right.

sentences.zh: 數遷工部尚書，加太子少保。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Minister of Works and granted the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to Minister of Works and granted the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 五年，主事吳可讀以死請為穆宗立嗣，祖廕被命集議，與徐桐等請申不建儲，彝訓疏存毓慶宮。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the clerk Wu Kedu petitioned with his death to establish an heir for Emperor Muzong; Zuyin was ordered to convene deliberation and with Xu Tong and others asked to uphold the rule against naming an heir, retaining the precedents of the Yuyu Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the clerk Wu Kedu offered his life in a petition to name an heir for Emperor Muzong; Zuyin was ordered to convene deliberation and, with Xu Tong and others, urged adherence to the rule against establishing an heir and preservation of the precedents of the Yuyu Palace.

sentences.zh: 明年，偕惇親王奕脤等辦中俄交涉。

translations.literal: The next year he joined Prince Dun Yizun and others in handling Sino-Russian affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he joined Prince Dun Yizun and others in managing Sino-Russian negotiations.

sentences.zh: 約既成，籌善後，條列練兵、簡器、開礦、備餉四事進。

translations.literal: After the treaty was concluded he planned for the aftermath, listing four items—training troops, selecting weapons, opening mines, and preparing provisions—and submitted them.
translations.idiomatic: After the treaty was concluded he planned for the aftermath and submitted a program of four items: training troops, selecting arms, opening mines, and stockpiling provisions.

sentences.zh: 命入直軍機，父憂歸。

translations.literal: He was ordered into the Grand Council; he returned home on his father's death.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered into the Grand Council, then retired on his father's death.

sentences.zh: 服闋，起權兵部尚書，調補工部，兼管順天府尹事。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was recalled to act as Minister of War, transferred to fill the Ministry of Works, and concurrently managed affairs as Shuntian Metropolitan Magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he was recalled to serve as acting Minister of War, transferred to the Ministry of Works, and concurrently managed affairs as Shuntian metropolitan magistrate.

sentences.zh: 大婚禮成，晉太子太保。

translations.literal: When the grand wedding ceremonies were completed he was promoted to Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: After the grand wedding ceremonies were completed he was promoted to Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十六年，卒，贈太子太傅，諡文勤。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he died; posthumously made Senior Tutor of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous name Wenqin.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he died; he was posthumously made Senior Tutor of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous name Wenqin (Diligent in Culture).

sentences.zh: 寶坻士紳感其救災勤勞，籥建專祠，報可。

translations.literal: Gentry of Baodi, grateful for his diligent labor in disaster relief, petitioned to build a private shrine; approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The gentry of Baodi, grateful for his tireless work in disaster relief, petitioned to erect a private shrine in his honor; the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 祖廕嗜學，通經史，好收藏，儲金石甚富。

translations.literal: Zuyin was devoted to learning, versed in the classics and history, fond of collecting; his store of bronzes and stones was very rich.
translations.idiomatic: Zuyin was devoted to scholarship, versed in the classics and history, and an avid collector; his holdings of bronzes and stone inscriptions were exceptionally rich.

sentences.zh: 先後數掌文衡，典會試二、鄉試三，所得多真士。

translations.literal: He several times held the literary juries, presiding over two metropolitan and three provincial examinations; those he selected were mostly genuine scholars.
translations.idiomatic: He several times held the literary examinations, presiding over two metropolitan and three provincial rounds; most of those he selected were genuine scholars.

sentences.zh: 時與翁同龢並稱翁潘雲。

translations.literal: At the time he and Weng Tonghe were jointly called the Weng-Pan clouds.
translations.idiomatic: At the time he and Weng Tonghe were jointly styled the Weng-Pan clouds.

sentences.zh: 李文田，字芍農，廣東順德人。

translations.literal: Li Wentian, style name Shaonong, was a man of Shunde in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Li Wentian, courtesy name Shaonong, was a native of Shunde in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 咸豐九年一甲三名進士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Xianfeng he was third among the first-rank jinshi and was appointed Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 9 he placed third among the top-tier jinshi graduates and was appointed a Hanlin Compiler.

sentences.zh: 入直南書房，充日講起居注官。

translations.literal: He entered the Southern Study and served as Lecturer and Diarist of Imperial Activity.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the Southern Study and served as Lecturer and Diarist of Imperial Activity.

sentences.zh: 同治五年，大考，晉中允。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tongzhi, in the great examination, he was promoted to Middle Sub-expositor.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 5, in the triennial palace examination, he was promoted to Middle Sub-expositor.

sentences.zh: 九年，督江西學政。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was made Educational Commissioner of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was appointed Educational Commissioner of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 累遷侍讀學士。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Reader-in-Waiting with academic rank.
translations.idiomatic: He was successively promoted to Reader-in-Waiting with academic rank.

sentences.zh: 秩滿，其母年已七十有七矣，將乞終養，會聞朝廷議修園籞，遂入都覆命。

translations.literal: When his term expired his mother was already seventy-seven; he was about to request leave to nurse her to the end, but hearing that the court was discussing repair of the imperial park, he entered the capital to report his return.
translations.idiomatic: When his term expired his mother was already seventy-seven; he was about to request leave to care for her in her final years, but on hearing that the court was debating repairs to the imperial park, he went to the capital to report his return.

sentences.zh: 既至，謁軍機大臣寶鋆，告以東南事可危，李光昭姦猥無行，責其不能匡救。

translations.literal: On arrival he visited Grand Councillor Baojun and told him that southeastern affairs were gravely imperiled and that Li Guangzhao was lecherous and baseless in conduct, reproaching him for failing to correct this.
translations.idiomatic: On arrival he called on Grand Councillor Baojun and warned that affairs in the southeast were gravely imperiled and that Li Guangzhao was licentious and unprincipled, reproaching him for failing to set matters right.

sentences.zh: 寶鋆曰：「居南齋亦可言，奚必責樞府？」

translations.literal: Baojun said: One may speak from the Southern Study—why must you blame the Grand Council?
translations.idiomatic: Baojun said, "One may speak from the Southern Study—why must you hold the Grand Council responsible?

sentences.zh: 文田日：「正為是來耳！」

translations.literal: Wentian said: That is precisely why I have come!
translations.idiomatic: Wentian replied, "That is precisely why I have come!

sentences.zh: 疏上，不報。

translations.literal: His memorial went up; no response.
translations.idiomatic: His memorial was submitted; there was no reply.

sentences.zh: 逾歲，上停止園工封事，略言：「巴夏禮等焚毀圓明園，其人尚存。

translations.literal: A year later, in a memorial stopping park construction, he wrote in brief: Parkes and others burned the Old Summer Palace, and they are still alive.
translations.idiomatic: A year later, in a memorial halting park construction, he wrote in brief: "Parkes and his fellows burned the Old Summer Palace, and they are still alive.

sentences.zh: 昔既焚之而不懼，安能禁其後之不復為？

translations.literal: If once you burned it yet did not fear them, how can you forbid their doing it again?
translations.idiomatic: If you burned it once yet did not fear them, how can you prevent them from doing it again?

sentences.zh: 常人之家偶被盜劫，猶必固其門牆，慎其管鑰，未聞有揮金誇富於盜前者。

translations.literal: When an ordinary household is robbed, it still must strengthen doors and walls and guard keys carefully; one has not heard of flaunting wealth with gold before the robbers.
translations.idiomatic: When an ordinary household is robbed, it still strengthens its doors and walls and guards its keys; one has never heard of flaunting gold and wealth before the robbers.

sentences.zh: 今彗星見，天象譴告，而猶忍而出此，此必內府諸臣及左右憸人導皇上以朘削窮民之舉。

translations.literal: Now a comet has appeared—a heavenly reproof—and yet you still bear to propose this; this must be inner-palace ministers and sycophants at the emperor's side leading His Majesty to policies that drain and impoverish the people.
translations.idiomatic: Now a comet has appeared—a heavenly warning—and yet you still propose this; this must be inner-palace ministers and sycophants at the emperor's side leading His Majesty to policies that drain and impoverish the people.

sentences.zh: 使朘削而果無他患，則唐至元、明將至今存，大清何以有天下乎？

translations.literal: If draining the people truly brought no other calamity, then from Tang through Yuan and Ming down to the present they would still stand—how then did the Great Qing obtain the realm?
translations.idiomatic: If draining the people truly brought no other calamity, then from Tang through Yuan and Ming the dynasties would still stand—how then did the Great Qing win the realm?

sentences.zh: 皇上亦思圓明園之所以興乎？

translations.literal: Does Your Majesty also consider why the Old Summer Palace rose in the first place?
translations.idiomatic: Does Your Majesty also consider why the Old Summer Palace was built in the first place?

sentences.zh: 其時高宗西北拓地數千里，東西諸國讋憚天威，府庫充盈，物力豐盛，園工取之內帑而民不知，故皆樂園之成。

translations.literal: At that time the High Emperor extended territory northwest by thousands of li; eastern and western states feared Heaven's majesty; the treasuries were full and resources abundant; park works were taken from the inner purse without the people knowing, so all rejoiced in the park's completion.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Qianlong Emperor extended the northwest frontier by thousands of li; states east and west feared Heaven's majesty; the treasuries were full and resources abundant; park works were paid from the inner purse without the people knowing, so all rejoiced in the park's completion.

sentences.zh: 今皆反是，聖明在上，此不待思而決者矣。」

translations.literal: Today all is the opposite; with sagely clarity above, this needs no thought to decide.
translations.idiomatic: Today all is the reverse; with sagely clarity above, this needs no deliberation to decide.

sentences.zh: 疏入，上為動容。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, the emperor was moved.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was received, the emperor was deeply moved.

sentences.zh: 俄乞假歸。

translations.literal: Soon he requested leave to return home.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he requested leave to return home.

sentences.zh: 光緒八年，遭母憂。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Guangxu he suffered his mother's death.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 8 he mourned his mother's death.

sentences.zh: 服竟，起故官，入直如故。

translations.literal: When mourning was over he resumed his former post and entered service as before.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he resumed his former post and returned to palace service as before.

sentences.zh: 數遷至禮部侍郎，充經筵講官，領閣事。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Vice President of the Ministry of Rites, appointed Lecturer at the Classics Colloquium, and headed Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was successively promoted to Vice President of the Ministry of Rites, appointed a lecturer at the classics colloquium, and placed in charge of Secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 二十年，疏請起用恭親王奕訢及前布政使遊智開，依行。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he memorialized to recall Prince Gong Yixin and the former Provincial Administer You Zhikai; the requests were carried out.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he memorialized to recall Prince Gong Yixin and the former provincial administer You Zhikai; both requests were granted.

sentences.zh: 明年，卒，卹如製，諡文誠。

translations.literal: The next year he died; condolence gifts followed regulations; posthumous name Wencheng.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he died; condolence gifts followed regulations, and he was given the posthumous name Wencheng (Sincere in Culture).

sentences.zh: 文田學識淹通，述作有體，尤諳究西北輿地。

translations.literal: Wentian's learning was broad and penetrating; his writings were well ordered; he was especially versed in the geography of the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Wentian's learning was broad and penetrating, his writings well structured, and he was especially expert in the geography of the northwest.

sentences.zh: 屢典試事，類能識拔績學，士皆稱之。

translations.literal: He repeatedly presided over examinations and could generally recognize solid scholarship; scholars all praised him.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly presided over examinations and generally recognized men of solid learning; scholars all praised him.

sentences.zh: 孫詒經，字子授，浙江錢塘人。

translations.literal: Sun Yijing, style name Zishou, was a man of Qiantang in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Yijing, courtesy name Zishou, was a native of Qiantang in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十年進士，選庶吉士。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xianfeng he became a jinshi and was selected a Bachelor of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 10 he passed the jinshi examination and was selected a Hanlin Bachelor.

sentences.zh: 聞杭州城陷，乞假歸，奉親闢居定海。

translations.literal: On hearing that Hangzhou had fallen he begged leave to return, took his parents, and relocated to Dinghai.
translations.idiomatic: On hearing that Hangzhou had fallen he requested leave to return home, took his parents, and moved to Dinghai.

sentences.zh: 參寧紹台道張景渠軍，平浙東有功，還授檢討。

translations.literal: He joined the army of Ning-Shao-Tai Circuit Intendant Zhang Jingqu, contributed to pacifying eastern Zhejiang, and on return was appointed Reviser.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the forces of Ning-Shao-Tai Circuit Intendant Zhang Jingqu, helped pacify eastern Zhejiang, and on his return was appointed Reviser.

sentences.zh: 以倭仁薦，入直南書房。

translations.literal: On Yiren's recommendation he entered the Southern Study.
translations.idiomatic: On Woren's recommendation he joined the Southern Study.

sentences.zh: 同治四年，擢司業。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tongzhi he was promoted to Vice Director of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 4 he was promoted to Vice Director of Education.

sentences.zh: 上言：「弭災在卹刑，治獄先平法。

translations.literal: He submitted: To quell disasters lies in lenient punishment; to govern prisons one must first even the law.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted: "To quell disasters one must temper punishment; to govern prisons one must first make the law even.

sentences.zh: 本律盜案不分首從，聖祖、世宗加以區別。

translations.literal: The basic code for robbery did not distinguish principal from accessory; the Sacred Ancestor and Shizong added distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: The basic code for robbery cases did not distinguish principals from accessories; the Kangxi and Yongzheng emperors added such distinctions.

sentences.zh: 自頃盜風充斥，概用重典，行十餘年，案不減少。

translations.literal: Recently robbery has filled the land; severe punishments have been applied universally for more than ten years, yet cases have not diminished.
translations.idiomatic: Recently banditry has spread everywhere; severe punishments have been applied across the board for more than ten years, yet cases have not decreased.

sentences.zh: 則知弭盜之術，不在用法之嚴。

translations.literal: Thus one knows that the art of quelling robbery does not lie in severity of law.
translations.idiomatic: This shows that the way to quell banditry does not lie in harsh application of the law.

sentences.zh: 請敕刑部改成例，复祖制。」

translations.literal: He asked the Ministry of Punishments to revise precedents and restore the ancestral system.
translations.idiomatic: He asked the Ministry of Punishments to revise the precedents and restore the ancestral system.

sentences.zh: 議行。

translations.literal: Deliberation carried it out.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was adopted after deliberation.

sentences.zh: 會上將侍太后幸惇親王府，既，與夏同善諫罷。

translations.literal: When the emperor was about to accompany the Empress Dowager to Prince Dun's mansion, afterward he and Xia Tongshan admonished and stopped it.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor was about to accompany the Empress Dowager on a visit to Prince Dun's mansion, he and Xia Tongshan admonished him and the visit was canceled.

sentences.zh: 未幾，復將詣恭親王府祀神，詒經再上疏，言：「聖學方新，宸修宜懋。

translations.literal: Before long the emperor was again to go to Prince Gong's mansion to sacrifice to the gods; Yijing again memorialized, saying: Sacred learning is just renewed; imperial self-cultivation should be vigorous.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the emperor was again to go to Prince Gong's mansion to offer sacrifices; Yijing memorialized again, saying: "Sacred learning has just been renewed; imperial self-cultivation should be redoubled.

sentences.zh: 經帷屢曠，則神誌難專；

translations.literal: If the classics lectern is repeatedly idle, then concentration of spirit is hard;
translations.idiomatic: If the classics lectern is repeatedly left idle, concentration of mind becomes difficult;

sentences.zh: 法駕時勤，則見聞易惑。

translations.literal: if the imperial carriage is frequently abroad, then what is seen and heard easily misleads.
translations.idiomatic: if the imperial carriage is frequently abroad, what is seen and heard easily misleads.

sentences.zh: 一日行幸，一日已荒念典之功；

translations.literal: One day's excursion is one day's neglect of the work of recalling the canon;
translations.idiomatic: One day's excursion is one day's neglect of the work of recalling the canon;

sentences.zh: 今日行禮，異日或啟遊觀之漸。」

translations.literal: today's ceremony may tomorrow open the gradual slide toward sightseeing.
translations.idiomatic: today's ceremony may tomorrow open the gradual slide toward sightseeing and pleasure.

sentences.zh: 士論歸之。

translations.literal: Scholarly opinion applauded him.
translations.idiomatic: Scholar-official opinion rallied to him.

sentences.zh: 遭父憂去，服除，仍原官，入直如故。

translations.literal: He left on his father's death; when mourning ended he held the same post and entered service as before.
translations.idiomatic: He left office on his father's death; when mourning ended he resumed his former post and returned to palace service as before.

sentences.zh: 十年，遷侍講。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was promoted to Lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was promoted to Lecturer.

sentences.zh: 五月朔，日食。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fifth month, a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 詒經以天道感應，本諸人事，於是有遇災修省之請。

translations.literal: Yijing held that heavenly responses correspond to human affairs; therefore he submitted a request to meet calamity with self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: Yijing held that heavenly signs respond to human affairs; therefore he submitted a request that the court meet calamity with self-examination.

sentences.zh: 十三年夏，彗星見，越數日，太白經天，人心惶駭。

translations.literal: In the summer of the thirteenth year a comet appeared; days later Venus crossed the heavens at midday; hearts were panic-stricken.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the thirteenth year a comet appeared; days later Venus crossed the sky at midday, and the people were panic-stricken.

sentences.zh: 詒經復有廣開言路及罷圓明園工程之請。

translations.literal: Yijing again requested broadly opening channels for memorializing and halting work on the Old Summer Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Yijing again memorialized to broaden channels for frank counsel and to halt work on the Old Summer Palace.

sentences.zh: 遷侍讀學士。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Reader-in-Waiting with academic rank.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Reader-in-Waiting with academic rank.

sentences.zh: 德宗纘業，大考一等，擢詹事。

translations.literal: When Emperor Dezong succeeded, in the great examination he ranked first class and was promoted to Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Dezong succeeded to the throne, in the triennial examination he ranked first class and was promoted to Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 召對，命直抒所見，連上澄吏治、慎海防機宜甚悉。

translations.literal: Summoned for audience, he was ordered to speak his mind plainly; he successively submitted detailed memorials on clarifying official discipline and careful maritime defense.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned for audience, he was ordered to speak his mind plainly; he successively submitted detailed memorials on clarifying official discipline and prudent maritime defense.

sentences.zh: 光緒六年，俄釁啟，東西海陸邊防亟。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Guangxu the Russian dispute erupted; eastern and western sea and land defenses were urgent.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 6 the Russian crisis erupted, and defenses on eastern and western sea and land frontiers grew urgent.

sentences.zh: 詒經言：「能戰然後能和，兵力專顧海口，北塘覆轍可鑑。」

translations.literal: Yijing said: Only when one can fight can one then negotiate peace; military strength must focus on guarding the river mouth—the Beitang debacle is a lesson.
translations.idiomatic: Yijing said: "Only when one can fight can one negotiate peace; military strength must focus on guarding the river mouth—the Beitang debacle is a lesson close at hand.

sentences.zh: 請調勁旅守東路，並津、永舉辦民團。

translations.literal: He asked to transfer crack troops to guard the eastern route and organize militia at Tianjin and Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to transfer crack troops to guard the eastern route and to organize militia at Tianjin and Yongping.

sentences.zh: 再遷刑部侍郎，明年，調戶部。

translations.literal: He was again promoted to Vice President of the Ministry of Punishments; the next year transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was again promoted to Vice President of the Ministry of Punishments; the following year he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 會左宗棠請修畿輔水利，乃疏薦張之洞、張佩綸資治理，並以山東河患，河員專治河堤，不講修導，建議購泰西機船及時修濬。

translations.literal: When Zuo Zongtang requested repair of capital-region waterworks, he memorialized recommending Zhang Zhidong and Zhang Peilun for governing ability, and because of Shandong river calamity—river officials only repaired dikes without dredging—proposed purchasing Western steam dredgers and timely dredging.
translations.idiomatic: When Zuo Zongtang requested repairs to the capital region's waterworks, he memorialized recommending Zhang Zhidong and Zhang Peilun for their governing ability; citing Shandong's river disasters, he noted that river officials only repaired dikes without dredging and proposed purchasing Western steam dredgers for timely dredging.

sentences.zh: 十一年，入直毓慶宮。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he entered service in the Yuyu Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he entered service in the Yuyu Palace.

sentences.zh: 山東河工領部銀百萬，詒經廉得書吏史恩濤苛索狀，嚴責繳還，將懲治，章未上，而御史王賡榮等輒劾以輕縱。

translations.literal: For Shandong river works he received a million taels of ministry silver; Yijing learned through investigation that the clerk Shi Entao had extorted funds and strictly ordered repayment; he was about to punish him, but before the memorial went up Censor Wang Gengrong and others impeached him for undue leniency.
translations.idiomatic: For Shandong river works he received a million taels of ministry silver; Yijing investigated and found that the clerk Shi Entao had extorted funds, strictly ordered repayment, and was about to punish him—but before his memorial went up, Censor Wang Gengrong and others impeached him for undue leniency.

sentences.zh: 上令明白回奏，覆奏入，卒陷吏議，並罷直。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered a clear reply; when the reply memorial entered, he was ultimately caught in censorial proceedings and dismissed from palace service.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered a clear reply; when his reply memorial was received, he was ultimately censured and dismissed from palace service.

sentences.zh: 有勸引退者，詒經曰：「吾被恩遇久，遑敢佚吾身邪？」

translations.literal: Some urged him to withdraw; Yijing said: I have long received imperial favor—how dare I indulge my person?
translations.idiomatic: When some urged him to withdraw, Yijing said, "I have long received imperial favor—how dare I indulge myself?

sentences.zh: 於是專治部事，佐度支凡十年。

translations.literal: Thereupon he devoted himself to ministry affairs and assisted the revenue bureau for ten years in all.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he devoted himself to ministry affairs and assisted the revenue bureau for ten years.

sentences.zh: 時議設銀行，造鐵路，慮利權外溢，龂龂持異議。

translations.literal: At the time there was discussion of establishing banks and building railways; fearing that profit and power would flow abroad, he stubbornly held dissenting views.
translations.idiomatic: When the court debated establishing banks and building railways, fearing that economic leverage would flow abroad, he stubbornly opposed the proposals.

sentences.zh: 詒經持躬清正，思以儒術救時敝。

translations.literal: Yijing conducted himself with integrity and sought to remedy the age's ills through Confucian learning.
translations.idiomatic: Yijing conducted himself with integrity and sought to remedy the age's ills through Confucian learning.

sentences.zh: 不阿權要，為同列所忌，卒不得行其志。

translations.literal: He did not flatter the powerful and was resented by colleagues; in the end he could not carry out his aims.
translations.idiomatic: He would not flatter the powerful and was resented by colleagues; in the end he could not carry out his aims.

sentences.zh: 先後數司文柄，深惡末學骫骳積習，擯之惟恐不遑，所得多知名士。

translations.literal: He several times held the literary examinations, deeply detesting the corrupt habits of shallow learning and excluding such candidates as fast as he could; those he selected were mostly renowned scholars.
translations.idiomatic: He several times held the literary examinations, deeply detesting the corrupt habits of shallow learning and excluding such candidates as swiftly as he could; most of those he selected were renowned scholars.

sentences.zh: 生平論學不分漢、宋，謂經學即理學。

translations.literal: In his life he did not divide learning into Han and Song schools, holding that classical learning is Neo-Confucian learning.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout his life he did not divide learning into Han and Song schools, holding that classical learning is Neo-Confucian learning.

sentences.zh: 又曰：「學所以厲行也，博學而薄行，學奚足尚？」

translations.literal: He also said: Learning is meant to strengthen conduct; wide learning with slight practice—what is learning worth?
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "Learning is meant to strengthen conduct; wide learning with slight practice—what is learning worth?

sentences.zh: 一時為學者所宗。

translations.literal: For a time he was revered by scholars.
translations.idiomatic: For a time he was revered by scholars.

sentences.zh: 十六年，卒，優詔賜卹，諡文愨。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he died; an excellent edict granted condolence gifts; posthumous name Wenque.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he died; an excellent edict granted condolence gifts, and he was given the posthumous name Wenque (Sincere and Diligent).

sentences.zh: 夏同善，字子鬆，浙江仁和人。

translations.literal: Xia Tongshan, style name Zisong, was a man of Renhe in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Tongshan, courtesy name Zisong, was a native of Renhe in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 咸豐六年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Xianfeng he became a jinshi, was selected a Bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, and was appointed Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 6 he passed the jinshi examination, was selected a Hanlin Bachelor, and was appointed Compiler.

sentences.zh: 累遷右庶子，充日講起居注官。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Right Sub-mentor of the Heir Apparent and served as Lecturer and Diarist of Imperial Activity.
translations.idiomatic: He was successively promoted to Right Sub-mentor of the Heir Apparent and served as Lecturer and Diarist of Imperial Activity.

sentences.zh: 十年，粵寇陷江南，諸軍無所統，請屬之曾國籓；

translations.literal: In the tenth year the Cantonese rebels took Jiangnan; the armies had no unified command; he asked that they be placed under Zeng Guofan;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the Taiping rebels overran Jiangnan; the armies had no unified command, and he asked that they be placed under Zeng Guofan;

sentences.zh: 又以北塘之役，僧格林沁軍退頓通州，桂良再就議款，同善建言敵情叵測，宜專任僧格林沁備戰守：敕並依行。

translations.literal: Also, because of the Beitang affair, when Sengge Rinchen's army withdrew to Tongzhou and Gui Liang again negotiated terms, Tongshan memorialized that the enemy's intentions were unpredictable and that Sengge Rinchen alone should be charged with war preparations and defense; both edicts were carried out as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: After the Beitang affair, when Sengge Rinchen's army withdrew to Tongzhou and Gui Liang again negotiated terms, Tongshan memorialized that the enemy's intentions were unpredictable and that Sengge Rinchen alone should be charged with defense preparations; both recommendations were adopted.

sentences.zh: 父憂歸，服闋，起故官。

translations.literal: He returned home on his father's death; when mourning ended he resumed his former post.
translations.idiomatic: He retired on his father's death; when mourning ended he resumed his former post.

sentences.zh: 同治六年，遷少詹事。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tongzhi he was promoted to Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 6 he was promoted to Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 其時傳言車駕將幸惇親王府，召集梨園，同善聞之，與孫詒經合疏諫止。

translations.literal: At that time rumor said the imperial carriage would visit Prince Dun's mansion and summon the opera troupes; on hearing this, Tongshan joined Sun Yijing in a joint memorial of admonition to stop it.
translations.idiomatic: At that time rumor spread that the emperor would visit Prince Dun's mansion and summon opera troupes; on hearing this, Tongshan joined Sun Yijing in a joint memorial urging that the visit be canceled.

sentences.zh: 略言：「皇上沖齡，敬天未至南郊，遊幸先臨府第，未安者一。

translations.literal: They wrote in brief: The emperor is of tender years; he has not yet worshiped Heaven at the southern suburb, yet an excursion would first visit a princely mansion—this is the first cause for unease.
translations.idiomatic: They wrote in brief: "The emperor is still young; he has not yet worshiped Heaven at the southern suburb, yet an excursion would first visit a princely mansion—this is the first cause for unease.

sentences.zh: 聖學端資養正，耳目玩好偶有所娛，恐疏而不密，未安者二。

translations.literal: Sacred learning depends on upright nurture; if the eyes and ears find occasional diversions in pleasures, one fears they will grow lax and inattentive—this is the second cause for unease.
translations.idiomatic: Sacred learning depends on upright nurture; if the eyes and ears find occasional diversions in pleasures, they may grow lax and inattentive—this is the second cause for unease.

sentences.zh: 近頃軍事未寧，遊觀之事傳播四方，曷以慰臣民望？

translations.literal: Recently military affairs are not settled; if sightseeing spreads in all directions, how can the hopes of officials and people be comforted?
translations.idiomatic: Military affairs are not yet settled; if sightseeing spreads in all directions, how can the hopes of officials and people be comforted?

sentences.zh: 未安者三。

translations.literal: This is the third cause for unease.
translations.idiomatic: This is the third cause for unease.

sentences.zh: 英、俄人士雜處京畿，稍示以懈，何能帖伏？

translations.literal: British and Russian people mingle in the capital region; if we show the slightest slackness, how can they be kept submissive?
translations.idiomatic: British and Russian nationals mingle in the capital region; if we show the slightest slackness, how can they be kept submissive?

sentences.zh: 未安者四。

translations.literal: This is the fourth cause for unease.
translations.idiomatic: This is the fourth cause for unease.

sentences.zh: 夫孝以禮為歸，禮以時為大，非時不舉，古有明箴。

translations.literal: Filial piety finds its fulfillment in ritual, and ritual's greatest principle is timeliness; what is untimely is not performed—antiquity has clear admonitions on this.
translations.idiomatic: Filial piety finds its fulfillment in ritual, and ritual's greatest principle is timeliness; what is untimely should not be performed—antiquity offers clear admonitions on this.

sentences.zh: 乞罷止以彰聖德。」

translations.literal: We beg that it be stopped to manifest sacred virtue.
translations.idiomatic: We beg that the visit be canceled to manifest sacred virtue.

sentences.zh: 出督江蘇學政，遭繼母喪去職。

translations.literal: He went out as Educational Commissioner of Jiangsu; on his stepmother's death he left office.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Educational Commissioner of Jiangsu; on his stepmother's death he left office.

sentences.zh: 起詹事。

translations.literal: He was recalled as Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled as Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十年，遷兵部右侍郎。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was promoted to Vice President of the Ministry of War on the right.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was promoted to Vice President of the Ministry of War on the right.

sentences.zh: 秋，患霪雨，奉其狀以上，乞申虔禱，實行敦節儉、廣賑濟、開言路、清庶獄諸政，語至剴切。

translations.literal: In autumn, afflicted by incessant rain, he submitted a report on conditions, begging sincere prayer and earnest implementation of thrift, broad relief, opening channels for memorializing, and clearing common prisons—his words were most earnest.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, amid incessant rain, he submitted a report on conditions, begging sincere prayer and earnest implementation of thrift, broad relief, opening channels for frank counsel, and clearing common prisons—his words were most earnest.

sentences.zh: 十三年，偕尚書廣壽詣四川按事，奏請撤永川等兵差局、綿竹等伕馬局。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he went with Minister Guangshou to Sichuan to investigate affairs and memorialized to abolish the Yongchuan military courier bureaus and the Mianzhu corvée-horse bureaus, among others.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he went with Minister Guangshou to Sichuan to investigate affairs and memorialized to abolish the Yongchuan military courier bureaus and the Mianzhu corvée-horse bureaus, among others.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，命直毓慶宮授讀，固辭不獲，益屏家事勿問，退唯默坐觀書，思所以為獻納地。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he was ordered to serve in the Yuyu Palace as tutor; though he firmly declined he could not refuse; he increasingly set household affairs aside, and in retirement would only sit in silence reading books, thinking how he might find a place to offer counsel.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 1 he was ordered to serve in the Yuyu Palace as tutor; though he firmly declined he could not refuse; he increasingly set household affairs aside, and in private hours would only sit in silence reading books, thinking how he might find occasion to offer counsel.

sentences.zh: 先後累言盜案刑例宜復舊制，分首從；

translations.literal: He repeatedly memorialized that robbery cases should restore the old statutes distinguishing principals from accessories;
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly memorialized that robbery cases should restore the old statutes distinguishing principals from accessories;

sentences.zh: 畿輔旱，請鑿井灌田甦之；

translations.literal: when the capital region suffered drought, he asked to dig wells to irrigate fields and revive them;
translations.idiomatic: when the capital region suffered drought, he asked to dig wells to irrigate fields and revive agriculture;

sentences.zh: 晉、豫飢，請移海防關稅經費卹之。

translations.literal: when Shanxi and Henan suffered famine, he asked to shift coastal-defense customs funds for relief.
translations.idiomatic: when Shanxi and Henan suffered famine, he asked to shift coastal-defense customs funds for relief.

sentences.zh: 四年，復命視學江蘇，陛辭日，力陳捐納有礙民生，無裨國用，稱旨。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was again ordered to inspect education in Jiangsu; on the day of his audience to take leave he forcefully stated that purchase of office harmed the people's livelihood and did not benefit state revenue; this pleased the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was again ordered to inspect education in Jiangsu; on the day of his audience to take leave he forcefully argued that the sale of offices harmed the people's livelihood and did not benefit state revenue; the emperor was pleased.

sentences.zh: 明年，被命巡視山東黃河，條上治下游三事：曰濬海口，曰直河灣，曰通支河，請移機器局經費治之。

translations.literal: The next year he was ordered to inspect the Yellow River in Shandong and listed three measures for governing the lower reaches: dredging the sea mouth, straightening the river bend, and opening branch channels; he asked to shift machine-bureau funds to carry this out.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was ordered to inspect the Yellow River in Shandong and listed three measures for the lower reaches: dredging the sea mouth, straightening the river bend, and opening branch channels; he asked to shift machine-bureau funds to carry them out.

sentences.zh: 其秋，閱緣江砲台，又歷陳三不可恃，請合數省力助守江口，已築者毋廢，未築者毋增，上然其言。

translations.literal: That autumn, inspecting the Yangzi coastal batteries, he again set forth three reasons they could not be relied on and asked several provinces to combine efforts to help guard the river mouth; what was already built should not be abandoned, what was not yet built should not be added—the emperor approved his words.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, inspecting the Yangzi coastal batteries, he again argued that they could not be relied on and asked several provinces to combine efforts to help guard the river mouth; what was already built should not be abandoned, what was not yet built should not be added—the emperor approved his reasoning.

sentences.zh: 嘗割俸濬江陰城河，植松五萬餘於君山，民德之。

translations.literal: He once cut his salary to dredge the Jiangyin city moat and planted more than fifty thousand pines on Jun Hill; the people were grateful.
translations.idiomatic: He once contributed from his salary to dredge the Jiangyin city moat and planted more than fifty thousand pines on Jun Hill; the people were grateful.

sentences.zh: 六年，卒，德宗聞之遽泣，其忠誠荷主知如此。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he died; when Emperor Dezong heard of it he wept at once—such was how his loyalty had won the sovereign's regard.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he died; when Emperor Dezong heard of it he wept at once—such was the regard his loyalty had won from his sovereign.

sentences.zh: 遺疏入，賜卹如例，諡文敬。

translations.literal: His final memorial entered; condolence gifts were granted as regulations provided; posthumous name Wenjing.
translations.idiomatic: His final memorial was received; condolence gifts were granted as regulations provided, and he was given the posthumous name Wenjing (Reverent in Culture).

sentences.zh: 子庚复，主事；

translations.literal: His son Gengfu became a Clerk;
translations.idiomatic: His son Gengfu became a Clerk;

sentences.zh: 敦复，御史。

translations.literal: Dunfu, a Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Dunfu became a Censor.

sentences.zh: 張家驤，字子騰，浙江鄞縣人。

translations.literal: Zhang Jiaxiang, style name Ziteng, was a man of Yin County in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jiaxiang, courtesy name Ziteng, was a native of Yin County in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 同治元年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he became a jinshi, was selected a Bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, and was appointed Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 1 he passed the jinshi examination, was selected a Hanlin Bachelor, and was appointed Compiler.

sentences.zh: 督山東學政，調山西。

translations.literal: He served as Educational Commissioner of Shandong and was transferred to Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Educational Commissioner of Shandong and was transferred to Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 遭父憂解職，服除，起故官。

translations.literal: On his father's death he left office; when mourning ended he resumed his former post.
translations.idiomatic: On his father's death he left office; when mourning ended he resumed his former post.

sentences.zh: 遷侍講，入直南書房。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Lecturer and entered the Southern Study.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Lecturer and joined the Southern Study.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，轉侍讀，充日講起居注官。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he was transferred to Reader-in-Waiting and served as Lecturer and Diarist of Imperial Activity.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 1 he was transferred to Reader-in-Waiting and served as Lecturer and Diarist of Imperial Activity.

sentences.zh: 五年，命直毓慶宮，遷侍講學士。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was ordered to the Yuyu Palace and promoted to Lecturer with academic rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was ordered to the Yuyu Palace and promoted to Lecturer with academic rank.

sentences.zh: 明年，劉銘傳奉召入都，疏請籌造清江浦鐵路，下李鴻章等議。

translations.literal: The next year Liu Mingchuan was summoned to the capital and memorialized to plan construction of the Qingjiangpu railway; the matter was referred to Li Hongzhang and others for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Liu Mingchuan was summoned to the capital and memorialized to plan construction of the Qingjiangpu railway; the matter was referred to Li Hongzhang and others for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 家驤念典學方新，講求上理，萬一言利之臣隨聲附和，一言僨事，關係匪輕，乃力陳三弊阻止之。

translations.literal: Jiaxiang, mindful that canonical learning was just renewed and the pursuit of higher principle was sought, feared that if profit-seeking ministers echoed one another, a single misstep would have weighty consequences; he forcefully set forth three harms to block it.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaxiang, mindful that canonical learning had just been renewed and the pursuit of higher principle was paramount, feared that if profit-seeking ministers echoed one another a single misstep would have grave consequences; he forcefully set forth three harms to block the project.

sentences.zh: 疏入，仍令鴻章覈覆，鴻章力主銘傳策。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, Li Hongzhang was still ordered to verify and reply; Hongzhang strongly upheld Mingchuan's plan.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was received, Li Hongzhang was still ordered to verify and reply; Hongzhang strongly upheld Mingchuan's plan.

sentences.zh: 然自是御史洪良品陳五害，侍講張楷陳九不利，並隨家驤而上諫書矣，事竟寢。

translations.literal: Yet from this Censor Hong Liangpin set forth five harms and Lecturer Zhang Kai nine disadvantages, and together with Jiaxiang they submitted admonitory memorials; the matter was ultimately shelved.
translations.idiomatic: Yet thereafter Censor Hong Liangpin set forth five harms and Lecturer Zhang Kai nine disadvantages, and together with Jiaxiang they submitted admonitory memorials; the matter was ultimately shelved.

sentences.zh: 數遷內閣學士，充經筵講官。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Grand Secretary with academic rank and appointed Lecturer at the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: He was successively promoted to Grand Secretary with academic rank and appointed a lecturer at the classics colloquium.

sentences.zh: 九年，授工部右侍郎，調吏部。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was appointed Vice President of the Ministry of Works on the right and transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was appointed Vice President of the Ministry of Works on the right and transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 家驤純謹好學，一謝時趨。

translations.literal: Jiaxiang was pure, cautious, and fond of learning; he wholly rejected fashionable trends.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaxiang was pure, cautious, and devoted to learning; he wholly rejected fashionable trends.

sentences.zh: 蒞官端慎。

translations.literal: In office he was upright and careful.
translations.idiomatic: In office he was upright and careful.

sentences.zh: 授帝讀，朝夕納誨，頗能盡心所職。

translations.literal: Tutoring the emperor, morning and evening he offered instruction and could fairly fulfill his duties.
translations.idiomatic: As tutor to the emperor, morning and evening he offered instruction and fairly fulfilled his duties.

sentences.zh: 十年，卒，上悼惜，賜祭葬如製，諡文莊。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he died; the sovereign mourned him and granted sacrificial burial as regulations provided; posthumous name Wenzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he died; the emperor mourned him and granted sacrificial burial as regulations provided; he was given the posthumous name Wenzhuang (Solemn in Culture).

sentences.zh: 張英麟，字振卿，山東歷城人。

translations.literal: Zhang Yinglin, style name Zhenqing, was a man of Licheng in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yinglin, courtesy name Zhenqing, was a native of Licheng in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 同治四年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tongzhi he became a jinshi, was selected a Bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, and was appointed Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 4 he passed the jinshi examination, was selected a Hanlin Bachelor, and was appointed Compiler.

sentences.zh: 十三年，命偕檢討王慶祺在弘德殿行走。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was ordered to serve with Reviser Wang Qingqi in attendance at the Hongde Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was ordered to serve with Reviser Wang Qingqi in attendance at the Hongde Hall.

sentences.zh: 英麟甫入直，即乞假歸省。

translations.literal: Yinglin had just entered service when he begged leave to return home to visit his parents.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglin had just entered service when he requested leave to return home to visit his parents.

sentences.zh: 未幾，穆宗崩，慶祺以有罪褫職。

translations.literal: Before long Emperor Muzong died; Qingqi was stripped of office for guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Emperor Muzong died; Qingqi was stripped of office for misconduct.

sentences.zh: 眾皆稱其志節。

translations.literal: All praised his integrity of purpose.
translations.idiomatic: All praised his integrity of purpose.

sentences.zh: 歷典福建、雲南鄉試，累遷祭酒，充經筵講官。

translations.literal: He successively presided over the Fujian and Yunnan provincial examinations, was repeatedly promoted to Chancellor of the National University, and served as Lecturer at the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: He successively presided over the Fujian and Yunnan provincial examinations, was promoted to Chancellor of the National University, and served as a lecturer at the classics colloquium.

sentences.zh: 光緒十七年，以詹事授奉天府丞，兼學政。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Guangxu, as Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent he was appointed Vice Director of the Fengtian Prefecture and concurrently Educational Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 17, as Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent he was appointed Vice Director of the Fengtian Prefecture and concurrently Educational Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 奉省士民樸素，隨軺所至，力加獎勸，學風興起。

translations.literal: The gentry and people of Fengtian province were plain and simple; wherever his inspection carriage went he vigorously encouraged them, and scholarly custom flourished.
translations.idiomatic: The gentry and people of Fengtian were plain and simple; wherever his inspection tour went he vigorously encouraged them, and scholarly custom flourished.

sentences.zh: 晉內閣學士，簡順天學政，擢吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Grand Secretary with academic rank, selected as Educational Commissioner of Shuntian, and elevated to Vice President of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Grand Secretary with academic rank, appointed Educational Commissioner of Shuntian, and elevated to Vice President of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，通州試竣回京，兩宮西狩，官吏遷避，英麟獨守學政關防待交替。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, when the Tongzhou examinations were finished and he returned to the capital, the two palaces fled west; officials fled or hid; Yinglin alone guarded the educational commissioner's seal awaiting transfer of office.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, when the Tongzhou examinations were finished and he returned to the capital, the two palaces fled west; officials fled or hid; Yinglin alone guarded the educational commissioner's seal awaiting his successor.

sentences.zh: 明年，召赴行在，應詔上疏，請力崇節儉。

translations.literal: The next year he was summoned to the temporary court and, responding to an edict, memorialized asking that thrift be vigorously upheld.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was summoned to the temporary court and, responding to an edict, memorialized urging that thrift be vigorously upheld.

sentences.zh: 乘輿回鑾，議變法，英麟言祖宗法制，可整飭不可遽更張。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage returned, reform was debated; Yinglin said the ancestral institutions could be rectified but must not be rashly overturned.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage returned, reform was debated; Yinglin argued that ancestral institutions could be rectified but must not be rashly overturned.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，充會試副總裁，借闈河南，改試策論、經義。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he served as Associate Chief Examiner for the metropolitan examination, borrowing the Henan examination grounds and changing the test to policy essays and classical exposition.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year he served as Associate Chief Examiner for the metropolitan examination, using the Henan examination grounds and changing the test to policy essays and classical exposition.

sentences.zh: 英麟嚴衡校，多取績學。

translations.literal: Yinglin examined strictly and selected many men of solid learning.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglin examined strictly and selected many men of solid learning.

sentences.zh: 會改官制，英麟以侍郎遷副都統，漢員授旗官自此始。

translations.literal: When the official system was reformed, Yinglin moved from Vice President to Vice Commandant; from this began the appointment of Han officials to Banner posts.
translations.idiomatic: When the official system was reformed, Yinglin moved from Vice President to Vice Commandant; from this began the appointment of Han officials to Banner posts.

sentences.zh: 旋晉都統。

translations.literal: Soon he was promoted to Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was promoted to Commandant.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，授都御史。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year he was appointed Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year he was appointed Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 時議行憲政，許士民上書，英麟必詳審為代達。

translations.literal: At the time constitutional government was debated and gentry and commoners were permitted to submit memorials; Yinglin always examined them carefully and conveyed them on their behalf.
translations.idiomatic: When constitutional government was debated and gentry and commoners were permitted to submit memorials, Yinglin always examined them carefully and conveyed them on their behalf.

sentences.zh: 御史江春霖直劾親貴，斥回原衙門，英麟率全台合疏留之。

translations.literal: When Censor Jiang Chunlin directly impeached imperial kin and was sent back to his original post, Yinglin led the entire Censorate in a joint memorial to retain him.
translations.idiomatic: When Censor Jiang Chunlin directly impeached imperial kin and was sent back to his original post, Yinglin led the entire Censorate in a joint memorial to retain him.

sentences.zh: 宣統改元，攝政監國，复舉輪講之典。

translations.literal: When Xuantong began his reign the regent supervised the state and again instituted the rotating lecture rite.
translations.idiomatic: When Xuantong began his reign the regent supervised the state and again instituted the rotating lecture rite.

sentences.zh: 英麟撰資治通鑑講章以進，皆發明精義，比附近情，冀以誠意相感動，章上，但循故事留覽而已。

translations.literal: Yinglin composed lecture chapters on the Zizhi Tongjian and submitted them, all elucidating refined meanings and drawing parallels close to human feeling, hoping to move others through sincerity; when the chapters went up, they were only retained for review according to routine.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglin composed lecture chapters on the Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Government and submitted them, all elucidating refined meanings and drawing parallels close to human affairs, hoping to move others through sincerity; when the chapters were received, they were only retained for review according to routine.

sentences.zh: 三年，武昌變起，內閣改制，飭都察院及凡有言責者皆停奏事，英麟嘆息以為奇變。

translations.literal: In the third year the Wuchang uprising erupted; the Grand Secretariat was reorganized and the Censorate and all who bore duty to speak were ordered to cease submitting memorials; Yinglin sighed, taking this as a strange transformation.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the Wuchang uprising erupted; the Grand Secretariat was reorganized and the Censorate and all who bore duty to speak were ordered to cease submitting memorials; Yinglin sighed, taking this as an extraordinary transformation.

sentences.zh: 遜位詔下，遂乞罷歸。

translations.literal: When the abdication edict was issued he begged to resign and return home.
translations.idiomatic: When the abdication edict was issued he requested to resign and return home.

sentences.zh: 德宗永遠奉安，猶奔赴崇陵謁送。

translations.literal: When Emperor Dezong was permanently laid to rest, he still hurried to the Chong Mausoleum to pay respects at the farewell.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Dezong was permanently laid to rest, he still hurried to the Chong Mausoleum to pay his respects at the farewell.

sentences.zh: 重宴瓊林，加太子太保。

translations.literal: At the repeat Qionglin banquet he was made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: At the repeat Qionglin banquet he was made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 乙丑冬，卒，年八十有八。

translations.literal: In the winter of the yichou year he died, aged eighty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the yichou year he died, aged eighty-eight.

sentences.zh: 張仁黼，字劭予，河南固始人。

translations.literal: Zhang Renfu, style name Shaoyu, was a man of Gushi in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Renfu, courtesy name Shaoyu, was a native of Gushi in Henan.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年進士，選庶吉士，授編修，入直上書房。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he became a jinshi, was selected a Bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, was appointed Compiler, and entered the Upper Study.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 2 he passed the jinshi examination, was selected a Hanlin Bachelor, was appointed Compiler, and joined the Upper Study.

sentences.zh: 出督湖北學政，以硃子小學、近思錄訓士。

translations.literal: He went out as Educational Commissioner of Hubei and instructed scholars with Zhu Xi's Elementary Learning and the Reflections on Things at Hand.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Educational Commissioner of Hubei and instructed scholars with Zhu Xi's Elementary Learning and the Reflections on Things at Hand.

sentences.zh: 累遷洗馬，充日講起居注官，補侍講。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Keeper of the Stud, served as Lecturer and Diarist of Imperial Activity, and was made up as Lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: He was successively promoted to Keeper of the Stud, served as Lecturer and Diarist of Imperial Activity, and was appointed Lecturer.

sentences.zh: 二十年，日本釁起，樞臣被劾。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year the Japanese dispute erupted and Grand Council ministers were impeached.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year the Japanese crisis erupted and Grand Council ministers were impeached.

sentences.zh: 乃與李文田等請起用恭親王奕訢，稱旨。

translations.literal: He then joined Li Wentian and others in asking to recall Prince Gong Yixin; this pleased the throne.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined Li Wentian and others in asking to recall Prince Gong Yixin; the request pleased the throne.

sentences.zh: 遷鴻臚寺卿，典試四川。

translations.literal: He was transferred to President of the Court of State Ceremonial and presided over the Sichuan examination.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to President of the Court of State Ceremonial and presided over the Sichuan examination.

sentences.zh: 除奉天府府丞，父憂，未之官。

translations.literal: He was appointed Vice Director of the Fengtian Prefecture; on his father's death he did not take up the post.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Vice Director of the Fengtian Prefecture; on his father's death he did not take up the post.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，拳亂作，奉命在籍治團練。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the Boxer uprising erupted; he was ordered to organize militia training while remaining at his native place.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year the Boxer uprising erupted; he was ordered to organize militia training in his home district.

sentences.zh: 服闋，赴行在。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he went to the temporary court.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he went to the temporary court.

sentences.zh: 時財匱，議加丁口稅。

translations.literal: At the time the treasury was depleted and there was discussion of adding a poll tax.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the treasury was depleted and the court debated adding a poll tax.

sentences.zh: 仁黼謂：「今日國勢極危，而人心未去者，良由世祖除明季三餉；

translations.literal: Renfu said: Today the state's situation is extremely perilous, yet the people's hearts have not departed—this is truly because the Founding Emperor abolished the Ming dynasty's three levies;
translations.idiomatic: Renfu said, "Today the state's situation is extremely perilous, yet the people's hearts have not departed—this is truly because the Shunzhi Emperor abolished the Ming dynasty's three levies;

sentences.zh: 聖祖詔丁口以五十年為率，嗣後滋生永不加賦：深仁厚澤，民不能忘。

translations.literal: the Sacred Ancestor decreed that poll registers be fixed at the fiftieth year, and that thereafter new births would never be taxed—such deep benevolence and thick grace the people cannot forget.
translations.idiomatic: the Kangxi Emperor decreed that poll registers be fixed at the fiftieth year and that thereafter new births would never be taxed—such deep benevolence the people cannot forget.

sentences.zh: 今議加丁稅，違祖制，拂民情，必不可。」

translations.literal: Now to discuss adding poll tax violates ancestral institutions and goes against popular feeling—it absolutely cannot be done.
translations.idiomatic: To add a poll tax now would violate ancestral institutions and go against popular feeling—it absolutely cannot be done.

sentences.zh: 事遂寢。

translations.literal: The matter was ultimately shelved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was shelved.

sentences.zh: 還京，擢順天府府尹。

translations.literal: Returning to the capital, he was promoted to Metropolitan Magistrate of Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: On returning to the capital he was promoted to Metropolitan Magistrate of Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 再遷兵部侍郎，典試江西，歷學部、法部。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to Vice President of the Ministry of War, presided over the Jiangxi examination, and served in the Ministry of Education and the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He was again transferred to Vice President of the Ministry of War, presided over the Jiangxi examination, and served in the Ministry of Education and the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，補大理院正卿，奏請敕部院大臣會訂法律，略言：「法律主要在乎組織立法機關，而所以成之者有三，曰：定法律宗旨，辨法律性質，編法律成典。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year he was made up as President of the Court of Judicial Review and memorialized asking that ministers of the ministries and courts jointly revise the laws, writing in brief: The main point of law lies in organizing a legislative body; to accomplish this there are three things: defining the purpose of law, distinguishing the nature of law, and compiling law into a code.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year he was appointed President of the Court of Judicial Review and memorialized asking that ministers of the ministries and courts jointly revise the laws, writing in brief: "The main point of law lies in organizing a legislative body; to accomplish this there are three things: defining the purpose of law, distinguishing the nature of law, and compiling law into a code.

sentences.zh: 中國數千年來，禮陶樂淑，人人皆知尊君親上。

translations.literal: For thousands of years in China, ritual has molded and music has refined; everyone knows to honor the ruler and revere superiors.
translations.idiomatic: For thousands of years in China, ritual has molded character and music has refined conduct; everyone knows to honor the ruler and revere superiors.

sentences.zh: 此乃國粹所在，必宜保存，用各國之法以補其不足。

translations.literal: This is where the national essence lies; it must be preserved, using the laws of various countries to supplement what is lacking.
translations.idiomatic: This is the national essence and must be preserved, using foreign laws to supplement what is lacking.

sentences.zh: 尤須造就法律人才，治法治人，相因為用，然後可收實效。」

translations.literal: Especially one must train legal talent; governing law and governing people mutually reinforce each other—only then can real results be obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Especially one must train legal talent; governing law and governing people must reinforce each other—only then can real results be obtained.

sentences.zh: 又言：「立法之要，規模不可不閎，推行必宜有漸。

translations.literal: He also said: The key to legislation is that the scope cannot but be broad, yet implementation must proceed gradually.
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "The key to legislation is that the scope must be broad, yet implementation must proceed gradually.

sentences.zh: 否則未當於人心而貿然以試，誠恐外國屬人主義勢力日益擴張，而吾國屬地主義處理愈形棼糾。

translations.literal: Otherwise, if it does not accord with popular feeling yet is rashly tried, I truly fear that foreign personalist jurisdiction will daily expand while our territorial jurisdiction grows ever more tangled in handling.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise, if it does not accord with popular feeling yet is rashly tried, I truly fear that foreign personal jurisdiction will daily expand while our territorial jurisdiction grows ever more tangled.

sentences.zh: 有司奉行不善，反使外人得以藉口，為患甚大。」

translations.literal: If local officials carry it out poorly, foreigners will instead have a pretext—this would be a very great harm.
translations.idiomatic: If local officials carry it out poorly, foreigners will instead have a pretext—this would be a grave harm.

sentences.zh: 疏入，多議行。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, most of its proposals were adopted.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was received, most of its proposals were adopted.

sentences.zh: 俄授吏部侍郎，充經筵講官。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Vice President of the Ministry of Personnel and served as Lecturer at the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed Vice President of the Ministry of Personnel and served as a lecturer at the classics colloquium.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，丁母憂。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year he mourned his mother's death.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year he mourned his mother's death.

sentences.zh: 未幾，卒。

translations.literal: Before long he died.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died.

sentences.zh: 仁黼內行修，不自標異。

translations.literal: Renfu's inner conduct was cultivated; he did not set himself apart.
translations.idiomatic: Renfu's private conduct was cultivated; he did not set himself apart.

sentences.zh: 嘗被命治河，卻例饋節省金，同官懼，謂將興大獄。

translations.literal: He was once ordered to manage the river works and refused the customary gift of surplus funds; colleagues were afraid, saying a major case would be raised.
translations.idiomatic: He was once ordered to manage river works and refused the customary gift of surplus funds; colleagues were afraid a major prosecution would follow.

sentences.zh: 仁黼忽索取金，眾始安，然頗怪其失操。

translations.literal: Renfu suddenly demanded the funds; the crowd was then reassured, yet many wondered at his lapse in integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Renfu suddenly demanded the funds; his colleagues were reassured, yet many wondered at his lapse in integrity.

sentences.zh: 已而河南巡撫上言紳士助學校金，不受獎敘，數與之同。

translations.literal: Before long the Henan governor memorialized that gentry had contributed funds to schools; Renfu did not accept reward or promotion, and the amount matched the funds.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Henan governor reported that gentry had contributed school funds; Renfu had not accepted reward or promotion, and the amount matched the funds he had taken.

sentences.zh: 朝士益服其清不絕物雲。

translations.literal: Court officials increasingly admired his purity that did not cut off worldly affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Court officials increasingly admired his integrity, which did not cut him off from practical affairs.

sentences.zh: 張亨嘉，字燮鈞，福建侯官人。

translations.literal: Zhang Hengjia, style name Xiejun, was a man of Houguan in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hengjia, courtesy name Xiejun, was a native of Houguan in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 光緒九年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Guangxu he became a jinshi, was selected a Bachelor of the Hanlin Academy, and was appointed Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 9 he passed the jinshi examination, was selected a Hanlin Bachelor, and was appointed Compiler.

sentences.zh: 十四年，視學湖南，念儒官為士模範，不激濁揚清，曷以勵風教？

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he inspected education in Hunan, reflecting that Confucian officials are models for scholars—if one does not stir the muddy and lift the clear, how can custom and teaching be encouraged?
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he inspected education in Hunan, reflecting that Confucian officials are models for scholars—if one does not stir the muddy and lift the clear, how can custom and teaching be encouraged?

sentences.zh: 疏薦文行交修者數人，士習為一變。

translations.literal: He memorialized recommending several men of cultivated literary conduct, and scholarly custom was transformed.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized recommending several men of cultivated literary conduct, and scholarly custom was transformed.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，入直南書房。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he entered the Southern Study.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he joined the Southern Study.

sentences.zh: 越二年，除司業，頻轉太常寺少卿。

translations.literal: Two years later he was appointed Vice Director of Education and was frequently transferred to Vice President of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later he was appointed Vice Director of Education and was frequently transferred to Vice President of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 一歲五遷，殊數也。

translations.literal: Five transfers in one year was an extraordinary number.
translations.idiomatic: Five promotions in one year was an extraordinary distinction.

sentences.zh: 二十六年夏，親貴大臣信拳民有神術能攘外，飾詞入告，上疑之，命亨嘉察視。

translations.literal: In the summer of the twenty-sixth year, imperial kin and senior ministers believed the Boxers had divine arts that could repel foreigners; they embellished their words in reports; the emperor was doubtful and ordered Hengjia to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the twenty-sixth year, imperial kin and senior ministers believed the Boxers had divine arts that could repel foreigners; they embellished their reports; the emperor was doubtful and ordered Hengjia to investigate.

sentences.zh: 亨嘉知其不可恃，條上弭釁機宜甚悉，疏甫入而亂作。

translations.literal: Hengjia knew they could not be relied on and listed measures to quell the dispute in great detail; the memorial had just entered when disorder erupted.
translations.idiomatic: Hengjia knew they could not be relied on and listed measures to quell the crisis in great detail; his memorial had just been received when disorder erupted.

sentences.zh: 西狩還，獨先賜用，徙大理寺卿。

translations.literal: After the flight west and return, he alone was first granted employment and was transferred to President of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: After the flight west and return, he alone was first recalled to service and was transferred to President of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 明年，出督浙江學政，頗採西國政教命題試士，多得通材。

translations.literal: The next year he went out as Educational Commissioner of Zhejiang; he often set examination topics from Western politics and education and obtained many broadly capable men.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he served as Educational Commissioner of Zhejiang; he often set examination topics from Western politics and education and selected many broadly capable men.

sentences.zh: 尚書張百熙、榮慶既為學務大臣，別置大學總監督，亨嘉遂被命任校事，仍不離內廷職。

translations.literal: After Ministers Zhang Baixi and Rongqing became Ministers of Education, a separate post of University Superintendent was created; Hengjia was then ordered to manage university affairs while still not leaving his inner-court duties.
translations.idiomatic: After Ministers Zhang Baixi and Rongqing became Ministers of Education, a separate post of University Superintendent was created; Hengjia was then ordered to manage university affairs while retaining his inner-court duties.

sentences.zh: 大學中更寇亂，肄業生不盈百，乃闢學舍，廣集高材生。

translations.literal: The university had again suffered from bandit turmoil; enrolled students numbered fewer than a hundred; he then opened dormitories and broadly gathered talented students.
translations.idiomatic: The university had again suffered from turmoil; enrolled students numbered fewer than a hundred; he opened dormitories and broadly gathered talented students.

sentences.zh: 類別學科，禮聘儒宿及東西邦學人專門教授。

translations.literal: He classified disciplines and ceremonially engaged veteran Confucians and scholars from East and West for specialized instruction.
translations.idiomatic: He classified disciplines and ceremonially engaged veteran Confucians and scholars from East and West for specialized instruction.

sentences.zh: 書籍儀器，粲然具備。
