translations.literal: Books and instruments were brilliantly complete.
translations.idiomatic: Books and instruments were abundantly provided.

sentences.zh: 兼攝進士館監督，進士習法政自此始。

translations.literal: He concurrently served as Superintendent of the Jinshi Hall; jinshi study of law and administration began from this.
translations.idiomatic: He concurrently served as Superintendent of the Jinshi Hall; jinshi study of law and administration began from this point.

sentences.zh: 歷光祿寺卿、左副都御史、兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: He served as Vice President of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief, and Vice President of the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Vice President of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief, and Vice President of the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 逾歲，疏辭校職，轉禮部侍郎，充經筵講官。

translations.literal: After a year he memorialized to resign university duties, was transferred to Vice President of the Ministry of Rites, and served as Lecturer at the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: After a year he memorialized to resign his university post, was transferred to Vice President of the Ministry of Rites, and served as a lecturer at the classics colloquium.

sentences.zh: 亨嘉為人敦實，嗜古精鑑賞。

translations.literal: Hengjia was solid and sincere in person, fond of antiquity and skilled in connoisseurship.
translations.idiomatic: Hengjia was solid and sincere in character, fond of antiquity and skilled in connoisseurship.

sentences.zh: 事母孝，母黃氏，壽百歲，同列奏庥瑞。

translations.literal: He was filial to his mother; his mother, née Huang, lived a hundred years; colleagues memorialized this as a blessing and auspicious sign.
translations.idiomatic: He was filial to his mother; his mother, née Huang, lived to a hundred; colleagues memorialized this as a blessing and auspicious sign.

sentences.zh: 中興後命婦享高耄者，與詹事袁葆恆祖母郭氏二人而已。

translations.literal: After the restoration, titled ladies who enjoyed extreme old age numbered only two—besides the grandmother Guo of Grand Mentor Yuan Baoheng.
translations.idiomatic: After the restoration, only two titled ladies enjoyed such extreme longevity—Hengjia's mother and the grandmother Guo of Grand Mentor Yuan Baoheng.

sentences.zh: 上聞之嘆異，加恩賜予。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard of it he marveled and granted additional favors.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard of it he marveled and granted additional favors.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，遭喪去，終服，仍入直。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year he left on bereavement; when mourning ended he again entered palace service.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year he left on bereavement; when mourning ended he again entered palace service.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年，卒，賜祭葬，諡文厚。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuantong he died; sacrificial burial was granted; posthumous name Wenhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 2 he died; sacrificial burial was granted, and he was given the posthumous name Wenhou (Generous in Culture).

sentences.zh: 論曰：同、光典學內直諸臣，每兼授讀，體制較隆；

translations.literal: The appraisal says: During the Tongzhi and Guangxu reigns, the scholars in inner palace service who presided over classical learning often concurrently served as tutors—the institution was comparatively elevated;
translations.idiomatic: The appraisal says: During the Tongzhi and Guangxu reigns, the scholars in inner palace service who presided over classical learning often concurrently served as imperial tutors—the institution was comparatively elevated;

sentences.zh: 而文學侍從，亦多選績學，時備顧問，稱榮幸焉。

translations.literal: and among the literary attendants, many of solid learning were also selected, at times serving as advisers—a distinction called honorable.
translations.idiomatic: and among the literary attendants, many men of solid learning were selected, at times serving as advisers—a distinction regarded as an honor.

sentences.zh: 祖廕好賢勤事，文田學識淹雅，同以通博稱。

translations.literal: Zuyin loved worthies and was diligent in affairs; Wentian's learning was broad and elegant; both were famed for comprehensive erudition.
translations.idiomatic: Zuyin loved worthies and was diligent in affairs; Wentian's learning was broad and elegant; both were famed for comprehensive erudition.

sentences.zh: 詒經重實學，同善崇聖德，家驤盡心誨納，英麟早勵風節，並無愧師儒。

translations.literal: Yijing valued practical learning; Tongshan revered sacred virtue; Jiaxiang devoted his heart to instruction and counsel; Yinglin early cultivated integrity of conduct—all were without shame as teachers of scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Yijing valued practical learning; Tongshan revered sacred virtue; Jiaxiang devoted himself to instruction and counsel; Yinglin early cultivated integrity of conduct—all were worthy teachers of scholars.

sentences.zh: 仁黼、亨嘉尤惓惓於明法修學，後先相望，其風采皆隱然可見焉。

translations.literal: Renfu and Hengjia were especially earnest in clarifying law and cultivating learning; one after another they succeeded each other, and their bearing can all be dimly seen.
translations.idiomatic: Renfu and Hengjia were especially earnest in clarifying law and cultivating learning; succeeding one another in office, their bearing can still be dimly discerned.
